description_en: Modifies the name, description, or retention period of a snapshot
description_zh: 修改一份快照的名称、描述或保留天数
name: ModifySnapshotAttribute

parameters.help_en:
The display name of the snapshot. The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length. It must start with a letter and cannot start with http:// or https://. The name can contain digits, colons (:), underscores (_), or hyphens (-).

The name cannot start with auto to avoid conflicts with automatic snapshot names
parameters.help_zh:
快照的显示名称。长度为2~128个英文或中文字符。必须以大小写字母或中文开头，不能以http://和https://开头。可以包含数字、半角冒号（:）、下划线（_）或者连字符（-）。

为防止和自动快照的名称冲突，不能以auto开头
parameters.name: snapshot_name

parameters.help_en: The description of the snapshot. The description can be empty and can be up to 256 characters in length. It cannot start with http:// or https://
parameters.help_zh: 快照的描述。可为空，长度为最大256 个英文或中文字符，不能以http://和https://开头
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to disable the snapshot instant access feature. Valid values:

true: Disables the snapshot instant access feature.
false: Does not disable the snapshot instant access feature.

Default value: false.

This parameter is deprecated. Standard snapshots of enterprise SSDs have been upgraded to https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/193667.html. No additional configuration or fees are required
parameters.help_zh:
关闭快照极速可用功能。取值范围：

true：关闭快照极速可用。
false：不关闭快照极速可用。

默认值：false。

该参数已弃用。ESSD云盘标准快照已升级为https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/193667.html，您无需额外配置，且不产生额外花销
parameters.name: disable_instant_access

parameters.help_en:
The number of days for which the snapshot is retained. The retention period is calculated from the snapshot creation time (represented in the ISO 8601 standard and in UTC+0 time in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format). Valid values: 1 to 65536.

The snapshot retention period can only be extended. Shortening the existing retention period of a snapshot is not supported
parameters.help_zh:
快照保留天数。设置该值时，快照保留时间会从快照创建时间(按照ISO 8601标准表示，并使用UTC +0时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ)开始计算。取值范围：1~65536。

快照保留时间仅支持延长，不支持缩短快照已有保留时间
parameters.name: retention_days
